tvShow.name: Dorohedoro
tvShow.overview: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido's help. In the Hole, that's a threat.

episodes.name: Mask Disparities
episodes.overview: A prequel story of how the mystical masks everyone wears within the Sorcerer world are created.

episodes.name: A Shop for You
episodes.overview: A prequel story of how Nikaido got ownership of her “Hungry Bug” restaurant and what it used to be, as the previous owner who took her in was a small-time sorcerer named “Syureon”.

episodes.name: A Low Level’s Youth - Graffiti -
episodes.overview: Nikaido goes on a small quest to have her picture taken to cement her place within En’s Sorcerer Mafia Branch.

episodes.name: The Gyoza Fairy That You Don’t Know
episodes.overview: A Tiny mischievous Gyoza creature secretly helps Nikaido’s “Hungry Bug” restaurant through it’s unusual & wacky ways methods.

episodes.name: Evil Dancing Masquerade Ball
episodes.overview: Invitations are sent within the En’s Mafia-family for a Specific tribal-Dance event leading to an interesting flashback from Shin’s past.

episodes.name: Blowin’ in the Night Breeze, an Oba Anniversary
episodes.overview: Caiman pays a visit to Nikaido at her Hungry Bug restaurant to deliver ingredients and learns first-hand how to make Gyoza.

episodes.name: Episode 13 (OVA)
episodes.overview: Caiman, Nikaido and members of the En Family offer glimpses into their macabre world in these six OVA shorts.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Caiman and Nikaido hunt for the sorcerer who cursed him with a lizard's head, while Fujita returns to the Hole to avenge Matsumura's death.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: "Cleaners" Shin and Noi get to work in the Hole. Meanwhile, Caiman and Nikaido search for a sorcerer who uses acupuncture to change faces.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Caiman and Nikaido take part in the annual Night of the Living Dead. But before they can finish their mission, Shin and Noi show up to finish them.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: En consults his comrade Turkey, whose magical dolls may identify the "lizard guy." Caiman and Nikaido visit Kasukabe, a professor studying sorcerers.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the sorcerers' world, Caiman and Nikaido locate a man with cross eyes, but the trail goes cold when Shin and Noi show up on a mission.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: En's mushroom magic gravely injures Nikaido when she infiltrates his mansion. Dr. Vaux and Professor Kasukabe tell Caiman about Shin's dark past.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Plotting to avenge Matsumura, Fujita joins the Hole Peace Hospital's baseball team: their rival team has his friend's killer Caiman on the roster.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Fearing for Nikaido's safety, Caiman returns to the sorcerers' world alone. The En family begins preparations for the Blue Night Party festivities.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Caiman sneaks into the festival grounds in pursuit of Risu. Meanwhile, En tells Fujita the story of how Shin and Noi became partners.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Nikaido dons a powerful mask to defeat her enemy, only to find the attack was a trap by En. With Tanba's help, Caiman visits one of the Cross-Eyes.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: As a member of the family, Nikaido learns why En needs a sorcerer who can manipulate time. Caiman disguises himself as Tanba's wife to rescue her.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Caiman tries to convince Nikaido to return to the Hole with him, but her contract with En binds her. After the fight, En launches a search for her.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Amnesiac Caiman seeks to undo his lizard head curse by killing the sorcerer responsible, with his friend Nikaido's help. In the Hole, that's a threat.

episodes.name: LET'S USE OUR RESOURCES WITH CARE / HORROR! BLOODY MANSION SLAUGHTER DANCE
episodes.overview: While Risu tracks down the Cross-Eyes' hideout, Kasukabe's group heads off to find the professor's estranged wife, only to make a gruesome discovery.

episodes.name: MEOTO ZENZAI / MASTEMA SUBNADE / THE TRAGIC TALE OF THE CROSS-EYES
episodes.overview: The battle heats up as Shin and Noi fight for their lives. Caiman and Nikaido find themselves being followed as they explore a bustling underground city.

episodes.name: SWEET HOME / SHINING YOUTH / MEMORIES KEEP CIRCLING ROUND AND ROUND / COME BACK HOME
episodes.overview: Ebisu regains her memories after eating En's new product. Meanwhile, Caiman experiences a violent flashback and Kasukabe goes grave-digging in the Hole.

episodes.name: GOLDEN BEETLES ARE RICH / CUTE BUTCHER / DOOR TO THE PAST
episodes.overview: So the Cross-Eyes gang figured they’d make the landlord’s murder look like a suicide, huh? As for Asu, who dared to keep things from me, I made sure he paid for it.

episodes.name: MEETING IN THE RAIN / TRAVEL COMPANIONS / FINAL NIGHT FOR TWO
episodes.overview: Looks like Ebisu got her memory back, thanks to eating some weird mushrooms, and now she’s all eager to head back to her parents’ place.

episodes.name: FAREWELL, CAIMAN / MEMORY BUBBLES
episodes.overview: En’s found the lizard guy and Nikaido, and they’re going at it hard. Meanwhile, the Cross-Eyes guys are sitting around swapping stories about their boss.

episodes.name: MY SECRET PLAN / CROSS-EYE EXPEDITION / DEFORMED REUNION
episodes.overview: Fujita's losing his mind trying to get Kikurage to bring Ebisu back to life. The Cross-Eyes guys are scrambling for cash, and things around En are starting to get kind of dicey.

episodes.name: CHAOS SHOCK / BLACK BOX / ROOM 501
episodes.overview: I never imagined En would go down that easily. The sorcerers are thrown into total chaos. And now I get why Nikaido doesn't use magic.

episodes.name: MOSH PIT / CROSS-EYES IN THE NEWS
episodes.overview: The Cross-Eyes boss has finally shown up. The En Family's been wiped out, and it looks like the Cross-Eyes have taken over that huge mansion.

episodes.name: LUCKY JERK / ADVANCED MAGIC
episodes.overview: Looks like they've found missing Kikurage. And that bastard Asu, well, Kawajiri now, is sneaking around, up to something weird again. That Haru chick’s getting a little too carried away.

episodes.name: BALLAD OF THE HAPPY DESTRUCTION / QUESTION & ANSWER
episodes.overview: Looks like Kawajiri and Nikaido have slipped into En's mansion, which the Cross-Eyes have taken over. There, Nikaido runs right into Aikawa. The mystery surrounding the Cross-Eyes boss just keeps getting deeper.
